name: Elfenbeingelübde
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE square 1:1 fantasy RPG inventory item illustration: the elegant late-medieval clothing ensemble "Elfenbeingelübde" from Göttliche Eleganz. The written garment description below defines the exact design, materials and colors. Both attached armor references define ONLY the illustration style, never their armor design, symbols or colors. Reference 2 defines the ITEM ART STYLE only: hand-painted illustrated fantasy inventory art, painterly textured metal, leather, wood and cloth, crisp dark outlines, soft simplified shading, muted warm colors, gentle illustrated highlights, readable details and a clear silhouette at small thumbnail size. Not photorealistic, not CGI or a glossy 3D render. Follow the written clothing design. Do not copy armor, heraldic creatures, plate metal or house emblems from either reference. Show the entire isolated object, centered and large within the square, with about 10% clear margin on all sides. Slight three-quarter view where appropriate; long weapons may run diagonally from lower-left handle to upper-right tip. TRUE transparent PNG alpha background; at most a very faint soft BLACK contact shadow immediately beneath the object. No living person, hands, face, scenery, floor, pedestal, frame, text, watermark or painted checkerboard. A plain WHITE tailor mannequin is specifically required by the user. Do not add unrelated objects.
Use case: stylized-concept. The ATTACHED ARMOR IMAGES ARE STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. Match their hand-painted fantasy INVENTORY art: bold crisp dark contours, subtly textured cloth, simplified warm shading, readable crafted details. If a THIRD clothing reference is attached, it defines ONLY the white headless mannequin, compact torso framing and presentation; do NOT copy its garment design or colors. NOT anime portrait art, NOT a photograph or realistic shop mannequin render.
GARMENT DESIGN (binding): Persönlicher Brautentwurf mit gefaltetem Schulterkragen und Wechselärmeln. Materials: Elfenbeinseide · Champagnerbrokat · Weißgold · Süßwasserperlen. Glatte Elfenbeinseide wird von schmalen champagnerfarbenen Brokatbahnen begleitet. Ein gefalteter breiter Schulterkragen liegt über einem kleinen hohen V-Ausschnitt; feine Weißgoldstickerei zeichnet Blattranken entlang der Miedernähte. Lange geschlossene Ärmel tragen wenige kleine Perlen an den flachen Manschetten. Die Garnitur enthält ein gefüttertes Innengewand, Brautkleid, zwei Ärmelpaare, einen schmalen perlenbesetzten Gürtel und einen abnehmbaren elfenbeinfarbenen Schulterumhang. Eleonora begleitet die Anproben; sämtliche genannten Weißgoldarbeiten und Perlen gehören zu dieser festgelegten Ausführung. Visible relevant details: Persönlicher mehrteiliger Brautentwurf; Unterlegte Weißgoldstickerei und kleine Perlen; Zwei Ärmelpaare und Schulterumhang. Argentisch-Cenyrisch fashion: late-medieval Italian elegance combined with northern Cenyr tailoring. These are CLOTHES, no armor.
PRESENTATION (user instruction): One single garment ensemble worn on a simple solid MATTE WHITE HEADLESS TAILOR MANNEQUIN, a half-body torso ending just below the hips. Feminine tailoring form; show the bodice, sleeves and the TOP of the skirt around the hips only. No full-length skirt or dress hem. White neck stump visible inside the collar, no head or face. Sleeves hang naturally at the sides, no posed arms or hands. No exposed human skin. No anatomical legs, lower legs, feet, shoes or boots. No pedestal or visible support pole. A compact upper-body inventory object, no full-body figure. Slight three-quarter view, shoulders and entire sleeves comfortably inside the square, large centered object with 10% transparent margin. Any cloak is draped compactly around shoulders and hips. Keep the garment fully readable at thumbnail size, vary the tailoring according to this design. TRUE transparent PNG alpha outside the clothing and mannequin, including open gaps. No ground shadow, aura, white outline, labels or extra props.
